grafici.settimana: Occupancy by day of the week

scrivi.troppiAllegati: At most {{ max }} attachments per message.

conversazione.chiusa: Conversation closed: reopen it to write.

manutenzione.statoCameraAiuto: Out of order takes the room off sale.

planning.aiutoTrascina: Drag a stay to another room or other days (on a phone, press and hold). Only stays that have not started can be moved.
planning.proposta: Move {{ codice }} to room {{ camera }}, from {{ arrivo }} to {{ partenza }}? The price will be recalculated.
planning.nuovaChiusura: Close a room or the property
planning.aiutoChiusura: Closed days cannot be booked. Existing bookings stay: they are listed below.
planning.conflitti: These bookings fall within the closure:

piani.aiuto: Adjustment on the daily price plus cancellation and deposit rules. The default one is offered on the website.
piani.variazioneAiuto: Negative for a discount, positive for a surcharge.

stagioni.aiuto: Periods with a different price. When two overlap, the higher priority wins.
stagioni.valoreAiuto: Percentage or extra amount (negative to lower it); with a fixed price, the nightly price.
stagioni.prioritaAiuto: Higher beats the other seasons on the same day.

promozioni.aiuto: Discounts applied automatically to stays that meet the conditions.

codici.aiuto: Codes to give to customers, who enter them when booking.
codici.eliminaAiuto: Whoever already used it keeps the discount.

pacchetti.aiuto: Stay and services at a fixed price, shown on the website with their photos.
pacchetti.eliminaAiuto: It disappears from the website; existing bookings stay.

tasse.aiuto: Municipal tax per guest per night. A month before it ends, with no next one, you get a reminder.
tasse.eliminaAiuto: Stays in the period no longer include it.

esterni.aiuto: Every 15 minutes the dates booked on the channels are blocked here too, room by room.
esterni.eliminaAiuto: The dates blocked by this calendar become free again.
esterni.urlAiuto: You'll find it in the channel's calendar settings (iCal export).
esterni.attivoAiuto: While disabled, its blocked dates are free until you enable it again.
esterni.sincronizzaAiuto: Reads the channel's calendar right away, without waiting for the next round.

esporta.aiuto: Paste each room link into the channel: it will see the dates already booked here.
esporta.senzaLink: This room doesn't have a link yet.
esporta.avviso: The current link stops working right away: you will have to paste the new one into every channel.

home.aiuto: JPEG, PNG or WebP. The first one opens the home page.

struttura.aiuto: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Common areas, outdoors and surroundings.

documenti.aiuto: Privacy, terms and cookie policy. A draft can be edited until you publish it.
documenti.eliminaAiuto: The draft disappears. Published documents stay.
documenti.versioneAiuto: E.g. 2026.1: different from those already used for this document and language.
documenti.pubblicatoAiuto: Published: it can no longer be edited. To change it, create a new version.
documenti.pubblicaAiuto: From then on it is the version in force on the website and can no longer be edited.

eventi.aiuto: Fairs, festivals and events that raise demand: they weigh on the suggested price.
eventi.eliminaAiuto: It no longer weighs on the suggested price.
eventi.impattoAiuto: From 1 (a few more people) to 10 (fully booked).

traduzioni.aiuto: The Italian text is the one in the form. An empty field uses Italian.
traduzioni.nessunaLingua: The website is in Italian only: enable other languages in the settings.

elenco.aiuto: Sorted by category and then by number, as on the website.
elenco.eliminaAiuto: It disappears from the website along with its translations.

faq.categoriaAiuto: Groups the questions on the website (e.g. Arrival, Breakfast).

recensioni.senzaCommento: The guest left only a rating.
recensioni.anonima: Shown on the website without the guest's name.

moderazioneAiuto.in_attesa: Not on the website yet: publish or reject it.

recensioni.rispostaAiuto: Shown on the website below the review. Leave it empty to remove it.

aiuto.annulla: For a payment recorded by mistake: no money is returned.
aiuto.rimborsa: Stripe and PayPal return the money to the guest; cash, card terminal and bank transfer are only recorded.

rettifica.forza: Even beyond the overpaid amount (e.g. goodwill gesture)

elenco.aiuto: Amenities are ticked on rooms, extras are bought with the booking.
elenco.eliminaAiuto: It disappears from rooms, packages and the website; existing bookings keep it.

servizi.iconaAiuto: Name of a Material Symbols icon, e.g. wifi or local_parking.
servizi.aliquotaAiuto: Empty: the default rate from the settings applies.
